exceptions.caveat: Variable name 'exceptions' conflicts with a Python built-in module.

frontend.placeholder_policy: Compile-only declarations; no execution or return-type assumptions.
frontend.typing_scope: Evaluate names, attribute paths and collections; dependency-name projection does not claim scalar type equivalence.

test.description: Define a dbt generic data test with local parameters.

macro.description: Define a reusable template function that can accept arguments and return rendered output.
macro.caveat: Macros perform no type checking. Variables defined inside a macro are local. Recursive macros may cause stack overflows.

if.syntax: {% if condition %}...{% elif condition %}...{% else %}...{% endif %}
if.description: Conditionally render blocks based on the truth value of expressions.
if.caveat: Conditions follow Python truthiness rules: empty sequences, empty strings, None, and 0 evaluate to False.

set.syntax: {% set name = value %} | {% set name %}...{% endset %}
set.description: Assign a value to a variable within the template. Supports both single-line assignment and block assignment.
set.caveat: Assignments are scoped to the current context. Block assignments capture rendered text, not expressions.
